title: Lawyers in impeachment trial bicker over translation of Duterte’s ‘yaman’

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Opposing counsels in the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte on Tuesday clashed over the use of the Tagalog word “yaman” to refer to her net worth in the statement of assets, liabilities and net worth (SALN). It was private prosecutor James Bryan Ibrahim Alih who mentioned the word “yaman” during his direct examination
